title: Oven Smoky Spanish Sea Bass Paella Valenciana
description: A smoky and crisp Spanish dish featuring sea bass, perfect for a sick day, made in a fondue pot and cut into sashimi style pieces, diabetic friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and saffron threads and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked calasparra rice and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Add the sashimi cut sea bass fillets on top of the rice mixture.
Transfer the fondue pot to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
